title: China holds at least one craft, via Puthoff

tellings.quote: China is like a closed door I know through how put up that they have at least one and I think he might have gotten that officially through some work he did with the DIA

plain: China holds at least one recovered craft of unknown origin, according to Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon research. Davis says he knows this through a scientist named Hal Puthoff, who he thinks may have learned it officially through work for the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Pentagon's military spy service. If true, the US would not be the only country holding such a craft.
